images.title: Five is ukasar ukasar urapon
images.purpose: Shows how the Gumulgal name for 5 is built from twos and one: 2 + 2 + 1.
images.composition: Plain white background, the main object large and centred with wide empty margins, no scenery, no characters, no extra decoration. Five large dots split into two pairs and one single dot, each group bracketed with its word underneath, and the number at the bottom.
images.exact_structure: Exactly 5 large dots in a row in three groups with clear gaps: group 1 is 2 teal (#0072B2) dots, group 2 is 2 teal dots, group 3 is 1 amber (#E69F00) dot. Under each group a small bracket and its word: ukasar under group 1, ukasar under group 2, urapon under group 3. Below the words, centred: 2 + 2 + 1, and under that, larger: 5. Nothing else in the frame.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec
any text beyond the listed visible text, or any listed text misspelled or altered
any board name, publisher name, book title, page number or curriculum branding anywhere in the frame
a hyphen used in place of a minus sign on any labelled number
images.takeaway: Gumulgal names count in twos: 5 is two ukasars and an urapon.
images.description: Shows how the Gumulgal name for 5 is built from twos and one: 2 + 2 + 1.
images.context: urapon 1, ukasar 2; 6 is ukasar-ukasar-ukasar and anything above 6 is ras.

image_decisions.why: Grouping dots in pairs makes the twos inside each Gumulgal name visible.
